newsitem.title: USA: Pepsi sees 98 profit for int'l beverages-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Pepsi sees 98 profit for int'l beverages-WSJ.

text.p: The chief executive of PepsiCo Inc's beverage operations believes the company's international business will "return to significant profitability" in 1998, the Wall Street Journal reported Monday.
Craig Weatherup told a group of consumer analysts in Florida that the company would curtail its international growth and take a more deliberate policy, the report said.
Earlier this month Pepsi said it expects its international beverage business to report an operating loss of about $25 million to $50 million in 1997.
Weatherup said that still holds true, but that PepsiCo Chairman and Chief Executive has asked for a $50 million improvement in operating profit in 1998.
"I guarantee you, we'll do one heck of a lot better than that," the report quoted him as saying.
